name: remote-pdf-printer-extension
description: Browser-Erweiterung (Firefox und Chrome): PDFs aus WebApp an den eigenen Druckserver senden

scripts.build: npm run build:firefox && npm run build:chrome
scripts.build:firefox: web-ext build --overwrite-dest --artifacts-dir dist --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json build.mjs "dist/**" "test/**"
scripts.run: web-ext run --start-url https://app.example.org --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json build.mjs "dist/**" "test/**"
scripts.sign: web-ext sign --channel=unlisted --artifacts-dir dist --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json build.mjs "dist/**" "test/**"
